subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI ever render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if so under what trust policy?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and prior merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX improvement changes that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve current behavior and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicitly approved proxy or opt-in design before rendering remote images.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy and tracking tradeoff, then update the renderer, sanitizer attributes, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together.

options.title: Fold into inline-media policy
options.body: Keep this focused issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 explicitly accepts or rejects remote Markdown images as part of the broader media plan.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve current behavior and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicitly approved proxy or opt-in design before rendering remote images.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy that drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
